stdout: === A. THE USUAL START (post first, work it out later) ===
"(not written)"
0/100 (0%) · Not ready to post

Blocked on: One-line purpose written; Exactly three themes; Every theme traced to seen / believe / done; Every theme survives the competitor test. Starting without these produces an account nobody can describe.
failed checks:
- One-line purpose written — "I help [who] with [what problem]" — without it there is no way to tell a good post from a popular one
- Exactly three themes — 2 named — three makes you known for something, ten makes you known for nothing
- Every theme traced to seen / believe / done — Untraced: Hiring tips
- Every theme survives the competitor test — A competitor's founder could post these unchanged: Startup lessons, Hiring tips
- Headline says who you help — Not a job title — the headline is read by people arriving from a post
- Featured section holds something usable — A sales page is featured. Feature a guide, a tool or a template instead
- Bank of at least 8 drafts before launch — 1 drafted — 8 is about four weeks at the usual floor, which is what carries you through a busy month
- Cadence is a worst-week floor — 5/week — set the lowest number you can keep in your worst week, then protect it
- "How did you hear about us?" is being asked — Most of this channel's results arrive privately. If you do not ask, you cannot see them
bank: 1 drafts
=== B. THE SAME FOUNDER, SET UP PROPERLY ===
"I help mid-market HR leaders fix onboarding that stalls in the first 30 days"
100/100 (100%) · Start posting
The purpose is written, the themes are yours, and there is enough in the bank to survive a busy month.
bank: 8 drafts, repeats: What we cut first
=== DRAFT CHECK (Step 6) ===
draft A — 24 words — not ready
- First line is a warm-up. Most people read it and nothing else — put the point there.
- 2 ideas in one post. A second idea is a second post.
- Figure with no source in the post: 70%. A borrowed number is how you end up correcting yourself in public.
- Engagement bait — "Agree?". It gets reactions from the wrong people.
- Engagement bait — Pointing-down emoji bait. It gets reactions from the wrong people.
- "Hiring tips" is outside the three themes. Post it elsewhere or change the themes deliberately.
draft B — 46 words — ready
Protect the floor, not the peak. In a heavy quarter, post from the bank and write nothing new.
This is a rubric, not a prediction. Judge the channel at ninety days, on conversations.
